weather.blurb: SYSC needs a location for the weather widget.
theme.title: Theme
theme.blurb: Pick a preset and a mode. The wallpaper drives the palette.
wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.blurb: SYSC uses wallpapers from this directory. Your other wallpaper tools stay installed.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.blurb: Choose plugins for the first run. Space toggles the focused item.
plugin.catalog: Choose extras later in the shell plugin catalog
confirm.title: Confirm
install.title: Installing
install.blurb: Installing the SYSC suite. This can take a few minutes.
done.title: Done
failed.title: Failed
refuse.distro: The SYSC suite supports Arch-family distributions. Full Debian and Fedora support is planned: https://nomadcxx.github.io/sysc/docs/
refuse.root: Do not run the installer as root.
refuse.niri: Start the installer inside a Niri session.
refuse.weather: A location is required for the weather widget.
warn.niri_session: This Niri session was not started with niri-session, so graphical-session.target is inactive. spawn-at-startup "sysc-shell" stays enabled, and the user units are enabled but not started. Start Niri with niri-session and run the installer again so systemd can start the bar.
conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.blurb: Choose what SYSC takes over; every choice is reversible.
conflicts.consequence.handover: Stopped and autostart disabled; uninstall restores it.
conflicts.consequence.keep: Left running; SYSC's daemon will not start.
conflicts.consequence.skip: SYSC's daemon is not enabled or started.
conflicts.dbus_failed: could not write %s; another notification daemon may still win the bus name
warn.conflict_kept: %s was left running; notifications may be shown twice
warn.conflict_failed: %s handover failed; it may still be running
wallpaper.invalid: Use an absolute path or ~/directory. The path cannot be empty.
confirm.system: System package: gSlapper via %s. The package manager may ask for sudo.
confirm.system.present: gSlapper is already installed • no system package changes.
confirm.system.missing: gSlapper will be skipped: no compatible package or package installer is available.
help.theme: ↑↓ selects a preset; ←→ selects light or dark. Your wallpaper supplies the desktop colors.
help.preset.standard: Standard keeps balanced spacing. ←→ changes the desktop mode; the installer stays black.
help.preset.compact: Compact saves space on smaller screens. ←→ changes the desktop mode; wallpaper supplies its colors.
help.preset.expressive: Expressive adds visual detail. ←→ changes the desktop mode; wallpaper supplies its colors.
help.wallpaper: Type a directory, then Enter. ~/ expands to your home. Existing wallpaper tools stay installed.
help.plugins: ↑↓ moves focus; Space toggles one plugin. These choices configure the first run.
help.plugin.weather: Weather plugin: weather details in the shell. Space toggles it; the built-in weather widget still needs a city.
help.plugin.media: Media plugin: playback information and controls. Space toggles it independently of weather.
help.weather: Automatic lookup uses your public IP. Type a city to override it; Enter with an empty field accepts the selected place.
help.conflicts: ↑↓ chooses a provider; ←→ chooses its action. Handovers are recorded so uninstall can restore them.
help.confirm: sysc-shell and its companions install together. Enter starts installation. Only the optional gSlapper package may ask for sudo.
help.existing: Existing shell configuration will be preserved. These defaults apply only when creating a new configuration.
help.install: Downloads are checksum verified. Use the package manager’s normal sudo prompt; SYSC resumes when it exits.
help.done: Review skipped tasks and warnings with PgUp/PgDn. The log records install results. Enter closes the installer.
help.failed: Scroll to the error and log path. Fix the reported cause, then rerun the installer. Enter closes this screen.
weather.invalid: The location service returned an invalid place name. Try a city search.
